messages:
Sasha (People Ops): Mateo's start date is 5/12. Need to confirm I-9 approach and group onboarding schedule. Mateo is remote. Ellen, do we have a verifier availability next week?
Ellen (HR): Available Tue & Thu mornings for remote verification. Mateo, can you do Thursday 9:30am PT? We'll need passport or DL+SSN. I'll also send the W-4 link.
alex-it: I'll prep laptop. Question: needs VPN, will they be on dedicated corp VPN or split-tunnel? Nia - any constraints?
Nia (Hiring Manager): Split-tunnel is fine. Add Mateo to eng-infra and data-team repos. No on-call for first month.
Mateo (newhire): Thursday 9:30 works. I'll use passport. Also need to add that I'm enrolled in the IRA plan, question about benefits eligibility date?
Ellen (HR): Benefits effective date is first of the month following 30 days. Since you start 5/12, benefits start 7/1 (first of next month after 30 days).
Sasha (People Ops): Also FYI background check vendor returns can take longer for international records. Mateo's address is in Canada. Ellen, please note potential delay.
HiringBot: CIYC checklist: onboarding email sent, benefits packet attached, bg-check initiated.
Ellen (HR): Verified: BG check vendor flagged a name match requiring manual review due to international records. I escalated to Security. ETA 48-72 hrs.
Mateo (newhire): Thanks. Anything I should provide to speed it up?
Ellen (HR): If you can upload any prior address history or ID supporting docs to the portal it helps. I'll send the secure upload link.
alex-it: Device provisioning steps:
```
# image and baseline
create-asset --model MacBookPro14 --owner mateo@redwood.com
apply-mdm-profile --profile standard
```
Sasha (People Ops): Action items: Ellen = remote verifier + bg-check follow-up; Alex = device; Nia = repo invites; Mateo = upload any extra docs if available. We'll reconvene if manual review completes.
Ellen (HR): Manual review cleared. Background check completed. Welcome aboard!
Mateo (newhire): Uploaded docs as requested and confirmed. See you on Thu for I-9. :wave:
